description: This file is a PHP test class for the EmployeeTimeAtWorkService, specifically testing the 'getTimeAtWorkResults' method within the Dashboard Service of the OrangeHRM system. It sets up test data, mocks necessary services, and verifies calculations related to employee work hours over specific periods.

classes.name: EmployeeTimeAtWorkServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmployeeTimeAtWorkService focusing on the correctness of time calculation results.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including service instantiation, test data population, and kernel configuration with mocked services.

methods.name: testGetTimeAtWorkResult
methods.description: Tests the 'getTimeAtWorkResults' method for different datetime inputs, asserting expected hours, minutes, and data count.
